name: Polymarket AI Trader
description: Paper-trading desk for Polymarket prediction markets. Pulls live markets from the public Gamma API, scores market quality, surfaces mean-reversion signals (longshot + favorite-fade), AI-gates each idea with your model, sizes positions with fractional Kelly, and tracks a simulated P&L ledger. Paper-only by default with a built-in seam to switch to live CLOB execution.
